x: Those to have finished the distance inside 9 hours and excluding the performances just quoted are Bellchamber (twice), Miles, Rathbone, Bentley, Martin (R.) (4 times), Bidgood (3 times), Rickards (twice), Urry (twice), Sutton (twice), Baker and Stirling Wakeley.

As usual Clive Gilby showed ahead at the very beginning (does this man know any other way of running) but as the first of the two 3¾ mile laps unwound a bunch of four began to detach themselves: Gary Staines, Jim Estall, Rathbone of Brighton & Hove and Kassa Tadesse loping along in predatory fashion just behind.
